page.overview:
Who is Adrianna Tereshkova?

Adrianna Tereshkova was born in , Russia, and was primarily raised by her father, as her mother has passed when she was young.

Her father loved Adrianna and her ambition to become a cosmonaut, frequently encouraging her with legends of the Archangel after whom their city was named. In their tales, the Archangel was a creature made of silver who would take chosen ones to the stars.

When Adrianna was sixteen, her sister Svetlana died in a car accident. Adrianna never went to the funeral and instead found comfort with a musician. Her father disapproved, and one year after Svetlana's death, he got drunk and confronted her.

Heartbroken by his sadness, Adrianna once again dedicated herself to becoming a cosmonaut. In her cosmonaut career, Adrianna achieved the rank of major and was sent into outer space on July 28th, 1980. Her father was unable to witness this culmination of a dream, as he had passed away due to heart failure 3 months prior. During extra-vehicular activity, Adrianna saw a sphere made of silver, which then collided with and destroyed their space shuttle. ). In the far future, the spheres had been part of Omnia, Mistress of Light. Omnia would lose her final battle against the darkness, but could not be destroyed. Instead, her power was dispersed into many small Orbs of Power. Another of these Orbs was bound to Cassandra Newland, who would turn into the enigmatic Providence.

entity.description:
Adrianna Tereshkova was born in , Russia, and was primarily raised by her father, as her mother has passed when she was young. Her father loved Adrianna and her ambition to become a cosmonaut, frequently encouraging her with legends of the Archangel after whom their city was named. In their tales, the Archangel was a creature made of silver who would take chosen ones to the stars.

When Adrianna was sixteen, her sister Svetlana died in a car accident. Adrianna never went to the funeral and instead found comfort with a musician. Her father disapproved, and one year after Svetlana's death, he got drunk and confronted her. Heartbroken by his sadness, Adrianna once again dedicated herself to becoming a cosmonaut.

In her cosmonaut career, Adrianna achieved the rank of major and was sent into outer space on July 28th, 1980. Her father was unable to witness this culmination of a dream, as he had passed away due to heart failure 3 months prior. During extra-vehicular activity, Adrianna saw a sphere made of silver, which then collided with and destroyed their space shuttle. A second sphere landed on Earth in Antarctica, where it was collected by the American government organization International Operations (I.O.).

In the far future, the spheres had been part of Omnia, Mistress of Light. Omnia would lose her final battle against the darkness, but could not be destroyed. Instead, her power was dispersed into many small Orbs of Power. Another of these Orbs was bound to Cassandra Newland, who would turn into the enigmatic Providence.
